The real relay records a pre-persistence retry and safe redelivery to agents/session-<UUID>. Pinned DSH persists exactly one plugin-sourced user/message, acknowledgement follows that durable record, and installed-relay status becomes delivered; lower-level coverage retains delayed persistence, no duplicate injection, restart recovery with empty memory, and no session-file fallback.
